messages:
alex.k: quick q — proposing a pin-exemption rule for deploybot.
I want safety but also fewer manual holds for low-risk SDK/runtime unpins during scheduled change windows.
Can we discuss criteria? :thinking_face:

maria.g: what's the basic idea?

alex.k: high-level: if a change is a runtime minor bump or SDK patch (semver patch) + low traffic model (p50  < 50 rps) + automated compat checks pass, deploybot can auto-unpin for the canary cohort.

jing: what are 'automated compat checks'? logs + inference smoke?

alex.k: yep — run the eval-suite + slow regression probe + latency smoke. If no functional regression and tail latency delta < 10ms then mark pass.

deploybot: [automatic] Received unpin-exemption-request for runtime v2.14.2 -> v2.14.3 from alex.k
Status: queued for compat checks

samir.r: need a gate for KV-cache-affecting releases — those should always require manual approval.

lisa: agree with samir. Also require a canary soak of at least 30 minutes before auto-unpin rolls to broader pool.

ops-runner: suggest we add a circuit-breaker: if any deploybot rollout sees error-rate + latency jump within first 10m, revert and re-pin.

maria.g: curious about observability — who owns alerts for these auto-unpins? we need SLA on notifications.

alex.k: propose notifications to #eng-oncall + pinned-change webhook to runbook service. Immediate DM to oncall if regressions.

deploybot: compat checks completed: eval-suite pass; latency-smoke pass; regression probes: pass
Recommended action: auto-unpin for canary cohort

jing: lgtm for canary if KB-cache flag is false. alex, can you add a flag check to the rule?

alex.k: adding flag check now — will update deploybot rules: add condition \"kv_cache_sensitive == false\" and minimum_canary_soak = 30m

maria.g: can we record a short release note when deploybot auto-unpins? e.g., "Auto-unpin runtime 2.14.3: reason=patch, checks=ok" so ops can trace.

alex.k: yes — deploybot will append a line to release-notes stream on success.

samir.r: documenting exception list is important — otherwise we'll get unexpected unpins. also add a cooldown per model to avoid churn.

alex.k: noted. I'll draft the PR with the rule, tests, and release-note change. Targeting canary rollout tomorrow 14:00 UTC during change window.

lisa: thanks. tagging @eng-releases for visibility :eyes:
